constraints: Use natural language similar to how a real employee would request a letter. Do not invent employee IDs or names — the bot shows them from its database.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
name: Employment letter HROPS approval flow
goal: Approve a pending employment letter request as HROPS

phases.description: Greet the bot and state intent to approve employment letters
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has shown pending employment letter requests with Approve and Reject options

phases.description: Click or type 'Approve' on the pending request
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has confirmed the approval and sent the email trigger
phases.recoveryHint: If email trigger fails, note the error but accept it as partial pass
